en_US.title: Black Keel Claim-Pool Charter
en_US.scanner: Carrier charter: claim-pool recovery asset, lien active, crew authority minimal.
en_US.terminal: CHARTER: BLACK KEEL operates as an automated salvage carrier under Aegir Reclamation Pool custody. Contractor transport does not imply rescue priority, hull ownership or clean exit rights.
en_US.audio: The carrier did not come for you. It came for a claim with your name attached.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Black Keel Claim-Pool Charter fixes the player carrier as rented salvage infrastructure. The player has access, not ownership; transport, recovery and payout are all filtered through claim-pool debt.
en_US.external_site: Black Keel is HECTON-8's hard-sci-fi answer to the escape-ship problem: a useful orbital asset that remains debt infrastructure, not a loyal personal vessel.
en_US.field_note: Use this on the first contract or carrier-status screen.
